relationships.subject: LGI1
relationships.evidence_quote: loss of LGI1 from both DRG and spinal cord neurons exacerbates mechanical pain-related hypersensitivity following nerve injury

key_findings: LGI1 is highly expressed in mouse and human DRG and dorsal horn neurons; its loss in DRG/spinal neurons (Hoxb8-Cre) but not Nav1.8+ nociceptors reduces Kv1 currents, increases small DRG neuron firing and dorsal horn wind-up.
Spinal LGI1 is upregulated after nerve injury and its ablation exacerbates mechanical hypersensitivity and allodynia, indicating a central protective role.
